rows.label: BLOOD BANK
rows.clue: A place for storing whole blood or blood plasma

rows.label: TENDER
rows.clue: Something that can be used as an official medium of payment

rows.label: BANKROLL
rows.clue: A roll of currency notes (often taken as the resources of a person or business etc.)

rows.label: BANK LINE
rows.clue: The maximum credit that a customer is allowed

rows.label: ENTAIL
rows.clue: Land received by fee tail

rows.label: EASY STREET
rows.clue: Financial security

rows.label: NET SALES
rows.clue: Gross sales reduced by customer discounts, returns, freight out, and allowances

rows.label: TIME PLAN
rows.clue: A system for paying for goods by installments

rows.label: PENSION
rows.clue: A regular payment to a person that is intended to allow them to subsist without working

rows.label: HOMESTEAD
rows.clue: The home and adjacent grounds occupied by a family

rows.label: CLAMS
rows.clue: Informal terms for money

rows.label: INLAND BILL
rows.clue: A bill of exchange that is both drawn and made payable in the same country

rows.label: BEARER BOND
rows.clue: A bond issued with detachable coupons that must be presented to the issuer for interest payments

rows.label: PLEDGE
rows.clue: A deposit of personal property as security for a debt

rows.label: BAD DEBT
rows.clue: A debt that is unlikely to be repaid

rows.label: SALVAGE
rows.clue: Property or goods saved from damage or destruction

rows.label: PASSBOOK
rows.clue: A record of deposits and withdrawals and interest held by depositors at certain banks

rows.label: HEDGING
rows.clue: Any technique designed to reduce or eliminate financial risk

rows.label: USURY
rows.clue: An exorbitant or unlawful rate of interest

rows.label: SMALL CHANGE
rows.clue: A trifling sum of money

rows.label: SUBLET
rows.clue: A lease from one lessee to another

rows.label: PHONE CARD
rows.clue: A card that is used instead of cash to make telephone calls

rows.label: HOT ISSUE
rows.clue: Newly issued stock that is in great public demand

rows.label: CHECK
rows.clue: A written order directing a bank to pay money

rows.label: RISK CAPITAL
rows.clue: Wealth available for investment in new or speculative enterprises

rows.label: MOVABLE
rows.clue: Personal as opposed to real property

rows.label: PITTANCE
rows.clue: An inadequate payment

rows.label: CREDIT SIDE
rows.clue: Account of payments received

rows.label: DEDUCTION
rows.clue: A reduction in the gross amount on which a tax is calculated

rows.label: FIVER
rows.clue: A United States bill worth 5 dollars

rows.label: TIME LOAN
rows.clue: A loan that is payable on or before a specified date

rows.label: TAX SHELTER
rows.clue: A way of organizing business to reduce the taxes it must pay on current earnings

rows.label: COVERAGE
rows.clue: The total amount and type of insurance carried

rows.label: READY MONEY
rows.clue: Money in the form of cash that is readily available

rows.label: PRIZE
rows.clue: Something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery

rows.label: HALFPENNY
rows.clue: An English coin worth half a penny

rows.label: OPEN ACCOUNT
rows.clue: Credit extended by a business to a customer

rows.label: BRIDE PRICE
rows.clue: Money or property given (in some societies) by the bridegroom to the family of his bride

rows.label: CASH FLOW
rows.clue: The excess of cash revenues over cash outlays in a give period of time (not including non-cash expenses)

rows.label: RATES
rows.clue: A local tax on property (usually used in the plural)

rows.label: TREASURY
rows.clue: The funds of a government or institution or individual

rows.label: EXPORT DUTY
rows.clue: A duty imposed on exports

rows.label: PRIVY PURSE
rows.clue: Allowance for a monarch's personal expenses

rows.label: GUARANTY
rows.clue: A collateral agreement to answer for the debt of another in case that person defaults

rows.label: CASH BASIS
rows.clue: A method of accounting in which each item is entered as payments are received or made

rows.label: PAPER LOSS
rows.clue: An unrealized loss on an investment calculated by subtracting the current market price from the investor's cost

rows.label: OVERAGE
rows.clue: A surplus or excess of money or merchandise that is actually on hand and that exceeds expectations

rows.label: LUMP SUM
rows.clue: A complete payment consisting of a single sum of money

rows.label: LEASEHOLD
rows.clue: Land or property held under a lease

rows.label: MORTGAGE
rows.clue: A conditional conveyance of property as security for the repayment of a loan

rows.label: OVERCHARGE
rows.clue: A price that is too high

rows.label: TOKEN MONEY
rows.clue: Coins of regular issue whose face value is greater than their intrinsic value

rows.label: TRAIN FARE
rows.clue: The fare charged for traveling by train

rows.label: DELINQUENCY
rows.clue: Nonpayment of a debt when due

rows.label: COST LEDGER
rows.clue: Ledger showing the accumulated costs classified in various ways

rows.label: FOUND
rows.clue: Food and lodging provided in addition to money

rows.label: SURTAX
rows.clue: An additional tax on certain kinds of income that has already been taxed

rows.label: DEDUCTIBLE
rows.clue: (taxes) an amount that can be deducted (especially for the purposes of calculating income tax)

rows.label: DEBIT SIDE
rows.clue: Account of payments owed

rows.label: TIME NOTE
rows.clue: A note that specifies the time (or times) of repayment

rows.label: INTANGIBLE
rows.clue: Assets that are saleable though not material or physical

rows.label: BENEFACTION
rows.clue: A contribution of money or assistance

rows.label: TRADE GAP
rows.clue: The difference in value over a period of time of a country's imports and exports of merchandise

rows.label: OWNERSHIP
rows.clue: The relation of an owner to the thing possessed

rows.label: PAYMENT RATE
rows.clue: The amount of money paid out per unit time

rows.label: CAPITAL GAIN
rows.clue: The amount by which the selling price of an asset exceeds the purchase price

rows.label: HIDDEN TAX
rows.clue: A tax paid unwittingly by the consumer (such as ad valorem taxes)

rows.label: RANSOM
rows.clue: Money demanded for the return of a captured person

rows.label: DIRECT TRUST
rows.clue: A trust created by the free and deliberate act of the parties involved (usually on the basis of written documentation)

rows.label: MEAL TICKET
rows.clue: A source of income or livelihood

rows.label: HOLE CARD
rows.clue: Any assets that are concealed until they can be used advantageously

rows.label: UPSET PRICE
rows.clue: (auction) the minimum price at which a seller of property will entertain bids

rows.label: PAPER PROFIT
rows.clue: An unrealized gain on an investment calculated by subtracting the investor's cost from the current market price

rows.label: TRUST
rows.clue: Something (as property) held by one party (the trustee) for the benefit of another (the beneficiary)

rows.label: BOTTOM LINE
rows.clue: The last line in an audit

rows.label: AIRFARE
rows.clue: The fare charged for traveling by airplane

rows.label: NET INCOME
rows.clue: The excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses)

rows.label: HALF CROWN
rows.clue: An English coin worth half a crown

rows.label: SECURED BOND
rows.clue: A bond that is back by collateral

rows.label: THINGS
rows.clue: Any movable possession (especially articles of clothing)

rows.label: TRUST FUND
rows.clue: A fund held in trust

rows.label: SHARE
rows.clue: Assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group

rows.label: GIVEAWAY
rows.clue: A gift of public land or resources for the private gain of a limited group

rows.label: DOLE
rows.clue: A share of money or food or clothing that has been charitably given

rows.label: PREMIUM
rows.clue: Payment for insurance

rows.label: ACCOUNT BOOK
rows.clue: A record in which commercial accounts are recorded

rows.label: TANNER
rows.clue: A small coin of the United Kingdom worth six pennies

rows.label: STOCK OPTION
rows.clue: The right to buy or sell a stock at a specified price within a stated period

rows.label: DIRECT LOAN
rows.clue: A loan by a lender to a customer without the use of a third party

rows.label: MERIT PAY
rows.clue: Extra pay awarded to an employee on the basis of merit (especially to school teachers)

rows.label: DRAFT
rows.clue: A document ordering the payment of money

rows.label: SURCHARGE
rows.clue: An additional charge (as for items previously omitted or as a penalty for failure to exercise common caution or common skill)

rows.label: LAGNIAPPE
rows.clue: A small gift (especially one given by a merchant to a customer who makes a purchase)

rows.label: COST OVERRUN
rows.clue: Excess of cost over budget

rows.label: BOOK VALUE
rows.clue: The value at which an asset is carried on a balance sheet

rows.label: FUEL LEVEL
rows.clue: The amount of fuel remaining
